newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil bolsas suspend trading of Caemi.
newsitem.headline: Brazil bolsas suspend trading of Caemi.

text.p: Brazil's bolsas have halted trading of mining company Caemi Mineracao e Metalurgia SA shares after the firm said it would raise $180 million from a new stock issue, a Sao Paulo Stock Exchange spokeswoman said.

She said trading of Caemi shares were suspended on Friday, but added that trading should resume on Tuesday. Brazil's securities and exchange commission normally requests bolsas to suspend trading in companies carrying out new share issues.
In a statement published in Brazilian newspapers, Caemi said proceeds from the share subscription would pay for investment.
Moreover, it said it was considering using part of the $180 million to acquire a stake in mining firm Vale do Rio Doce, whose privatization is slated for April 29.
The statement said Japanese Mitsui & Co agreed to buy 40 percent of Caemi's voting stock and up to 40 percent of the firm's preferred stock.
Caemi preferred shares closed at 66.90 reais on Friday.
